create_HFDataset: create an HFDataset from a HuggingFace dataset for TTS training with resampling and mel spectrogram extraction
create_CustomDataset: create a CustomDataset from local audio files with optional preprocessed mel spectrograms and duration filtering
build_DynamicBatchSampler: build a DynamicBatchSampler that groups samples by audio length to minimize padding within each batch
load_dataset: load a TTS dataset from disk or HuggingFace with configurable tokenizer, audio type, and mel spec settings
collate_fn: collate a batch of mel spectrograms and texts with zero-padding and length tensors for DataLoader
